remarks: Experience the perfect blend of modern luxury and historic character in this exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located in one of Downtown Stamford's most sought-after boutique buildings. With only 7 loft-style units, this exclusive residence offers a rare opportunity to enjoy refined condo living in a vibrant city setting.  From the moment you enter, you're welcomed by soaring ceilings, rich weathered oak floors, and striking exposed brick that add warmth and charm. Oversized Pella windows stretch across the main living space, filling the home with natural light and enhancing the open, airy layout. The kitchen has been fully renovated with high-end finishes including Caesarstone countertops, Samsung stainless steel appliances, and Moen fixtures, seamlessly blending style with functionality.  Both bathrooms are thoughtfully designed with modern touches, and the unit includes the convenience of an in-unit GE washer and dryer. The building features secure elevator access, interior mailboxes, and optional tenant parking available at the nearby Bell Street garage for an additional fee.  Set in the heart of Downtown Stamford, just steps from top-rated restaurants, boutique shopping, and Metro-North, this is true city living with a sophisticated edge. If you're looking for a move-in ready condo with NYC vibes and suburban convenience-this is the one.
